title: Scientific revolutions
learning_outcomes: Explain scientific breakthroughs in the context of scientific revolutions.
Compare and distinguish evidence and paradigms in the context of scientific revolutions.
Apply technology adoption in the context of scientific revolutions.
Evaluate and justify decisions about social consequences in the context of scientific revolutions.

lessons.title: Scientific breakthroughs
lessons.outcome: Explain scientific breakthroughs in the context of scientific revolutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving scientific breakthroughs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to scientific history essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain scientific breakthroughs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of scientific breakthroughs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Evidence and paradigms
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish evidence and paradigms in the context of scientific revolutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving evidence and paradigms; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to scientific history essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain evidence and paradigms from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of evidence and paradigms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Technology adoption
lessons.outcome: Apply technology adoption in the context of scientific revolutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving technology adoption; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to scientific history essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain technology adoption from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of technology adoption; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Social consequences
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about social consequences in the context of scientific revolutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving social consequences; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to scientific history essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain social consequences from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of social consequences; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of scientific breakthroughs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of evidence and paradigms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of technology adoption; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of social consequences; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
